unresolved_uncertainty.what: Several fields the licence does not cover still contain WEB-paragraph text: observed_substrate_signals of W6-001, W6-004, W6-005, W6-007, W6-009, W6-010 and W6-013; W6-005.strongest_rejected_alternative ('Splitting at 15:42 on the WEB paragraph and the application formula'); and W6-009.boundary_rationale ('opens a WEB paragraph at 16:12'; 'with a WEB paragraph at 16:13 as well'). None is a CWO-1COR-01 A or B hit. I left them byte-identical.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: Strategy section 8 rule 4 may still bear on them. Removing them needs a new ruling and licence.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: How I read S1-01b's 'keep at most one bare RP pilcrow location item per row': it limits bare location-only items. W6-002, W6-003, W6-011 and W6-012 each keep one bare item plus one existing close-seam-qualified pilcrow item (for example 'RP pilcrow on the close seam (15:20)'). No exact span names those items, so I did not remove them. The rationales still carry close-seam pilcrow location mentions, and no exact span names those either.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: This is an inferred reading. If the controlling agent meant at most one pilcrow mention of any kind per row, a further deletion is needed.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: W6-012: I deleted the corroboration clause and kept the content argument as 'The greeting formula carries the onset.', following the instruction that 'the greeting-formula content stays'. W6-003 and W6-011 now read 'RP pilcrow at X stands on the onset.', with only the verb changed for agreement. W6-005 keeps 'An RP pilcrow at 15:35 informs the onset.' with nothing added.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: These are the minimal rewordings the deletions required. A reviewer may prefer different wording.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: With the W6 deletions alone, ngram7 already reads GREEN on the combined copy: the gram 'rp pilcrow at and web paragraph at' remains in 5 W5 rows, below gate 10.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: W5's own fix-up must still remove it. GREEN here does not certify W5.
